title: Align AI to Dynamic Human-AI Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2607.14240v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Current alignment approaches typically focus on emulating human behavior using static representations of human preferences, failing to capture the dynamic, context-dependent nature of real-world human-AI interactions. In this paper, we argue for a shift from static and emulative to interactive and complementary alignment, where preferences emerge through interaction and alignment is defined not by satisfying preferences alone. We first formalize this gap by contrasting existing alignment with a trajectory-level view in which human and model behavior co-evolve over time. Because these interaction dynamics have not been adequately captured within existing ML formulations, we ground this perspective in insights from an interdisciplinary workshop. translated_title: 将AI对齐到动态的人机工作流
translated_abstract: 当前的对齐方法通常侧重于使用人类偏好的静态表示来模拟人类行为，未能捕捉现实世界中人机交互的动态性和上下文依赖特性。在本文中，我们主张从静态和模仿式的对齐转向交互式和互补式的对齐，其中偏好通过交互而产生，而对齐的定义不应仅仅是满足偏好。我们首先通过将现有对齐方法与轨迹层面的视角进行对比来形式化这一差距，在该视角下，人类和模型的行为会随时间共同演化。由于这些交互动态尚未在现有的机器学习框架中得到充分刻画，我们基于一次跨学科研讨会的见解来构建这一视角。我们借鉴社会科学中关于人与人协作的研究成果，进而论证人机系统会放大这些动态特性，引入新的不对称性，使得对……的推理（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出将AI对齐范式从静态模仿人类偏好转向交互式、互补式对齐，即偏好应在人机交互中动态涌现，且对齐的衡量标准不应仅限于满足静态偏好。
en_tdlr: This paper argues for shifting AI alignment from static, emulative modeling of human preferences to an interactive, complementary paradigm in which preferences dynamically emerge through human-AI interaction and alignment is defined beyond merely satisfying static preferences.
